Contrasts of Firth logistic regression models

Source: R/ContrastFirth.R
ContrastsFirth.Rd

Wald tests of contrasts of ModelFirth fits, one per subject and contrast, on the log-odds scale of protein detection. The reference distribution is normal (df = Inf), as in the coefficient table of logistf and confint(). Used by the firth method of build_contrast_analysis().

Value

An R6 class generator.

See also

Examples


istar <- sim_lfq_data_protein_config(n_proteins = 10, weight_missing = 1, seed = 3)
#> `protein_Id`: columns `proteinID`, `idtype2` united with separator '~'.
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> setup_analysis: dropped 5 unconfigured columns: average_prot_abundance, sd, mean, N, Replicate.
#> setup_analysis: added 39 rows with NA response for feature and sample combinations absent from the input.
modi <- build_model_glm_protein(LFQData$new(istar$data, istar$config), "~ group_")
contrasts <- c(Avs = "group_A - group_B", AvsCtrl = "group_A - group_Ctrl")

ctr <- ContrastsFirth$new(modi,contrasts)
ctr$get_contrast_sides()
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>   contrast group_1 group_2   
#>   <chr>    <chr>   <chr>     
#> 1 Avs      group_A group_B   
#> 2 AvsCtrl  group_A group_Ctrl
